messages:
marta: Quick broadcast  we're tightening canary policies and running a short load-check. Please read and ack if this conflicts with your rollouts.

marta: Policy highlights: new canary pause condition = sustained error burn-rate 3x baseline for 8m (previously 6x for 15m). Aim is faster detection of regressions during model/promote flows. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-policy

lee: When's the load-check?

marta: Wed Apr 7 2026 01:00-02:00 UTC. Scope: traffic replay + AZ failover simulation in us-east-1 canaries. No planned customer downtime but expect canary latencies to spike and transient 5xxs.

samir: Will we auto-evict models or just pause?

marta: Just pause canaries and open an incident. No automatic global rollback. Ops will decide next steps.

olivia: I'll add a temporary dashboard with p50/p95/p99, 5xx rate, kv-miss, and queue depth. Pager if 5xx > 20% for 3m.

oncall-bot: Calendar event created: "Canary policy tighten + load-check" Wed Apr 07 01:00-02:00 UTC  invites: #eng-sre #eng-runtime #product-ops

marta: Pre-checks: confirm canary tagging, ensure promo hooks disabled 00:30-02:30 UTC, validate rollback playbook access. Abort commands: `kubectl scale deploy/loadtest -n stress --replicas=0` and `infractl routing set-weight --pool canary --weight 0`.

lee: Acked  I'll disable auto-promote and ping release owners.

samir: Acked  I'll be on rotation that window.

olivia: :eyes: will post dashboard link 30m prior.

marta: Thanks everyone. React with :white_check_mark: once you've read.

lee: :white_check_mark:

samir: :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: Incident channel created: #incident-canary-policy-1799991111
